data-for-creating-registries-on-shared-s.text: Data for creating registries on shared script publications.
Issue 745. Records the ticket introduces or changes, their fields and their rules. Placement is in the modules model.

state-rules.text: A reference output is live only if it is unspent and the script it carries hashes to the expected hash; the hash.
covers the language, the bytes and the applied parameters, so a different application policy or release has a different hash and is never reused.
A creation that finds both live copies sends exactly one transaction and creates no reference output.
A creation that finds one copy missing publishes exactly that script.
Locked ADA of a reference output is its minimum ADA, kept apart from the fee of the transaction that created it.
